name: femkit-frontend
description: The femkit web page, built by `femkit web build` into femkit/web/static/ (docs/contracts/web.md § 3)

scripts.types: json2ts --input src/generated/schemas.json --output src/generated/schemas.ts --unreachableDefinitions --no-additionalProperties --bannerComment "// generated by web build from src/generated/schemas.json -- do not edit"
scripts.build: npm run types && tsc --noEmit && vite build
